snippet.title: Path of the Jedi - Shockwave Player - 2008
snippet.description:
This game is set between  Ep2 and 3 and it was a promo game for the animated show Star Wars - The Clone Wars.

This was really nice, I liked that one could pick who you wanna play. Though I think the game was a bit broken at the end, where the hell is that last computer :/

Try and find it here:
http://www.gamegape.com/en-1759-path-of-jedi.html
